# Kata artwork

`kata-logo.svg` is the unmodified Kata Containers icon from the
[official website repository](https://github.com/kata-containers/www.katacontainers.io/blob/master/static/img/logo_ico1.svg).
Kata Containers branding belongs to its respective owners.

The padlock beside it uses the MIT-licensed
[Heroicons lock-closed icon](https://github.com/tailwindlabs/heroicons/blob/master/optimized/24/outline/lock-closed.svg).
